en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the subject is to provide students with knowledge about agricultural commodities and the principles of the market for agricultural commodities and to familiarize them with the basic tools in animal production, especially with the science of feed, with systems of evaluating and assessing the quality and safety of feed for the production of healthy food.
